Filing gate: ① a repeatedly red platform test with a named location, measured from the Actions job logs. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: p1, under the standing order that a repeatedly red platform test gets fixed.

## 维护者速读

`packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts`（"os validate is the read-only superset of os build"）在 `Test Core (4/8)` 里两次卡在 vitest 默认的 5 秒超时：一次让 main 推送红，一次把合并队列里的一组踢出。两次的 diff 都与 cli 无关。

## Measured

| When | Where | Job |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-05 18:18Z | `main` push `CI` on `25fea77a` (green again on the next two pushes) | 127442019825 |
| 2026-11-06 02:17Z | merge group `pr-30753` (`fix(lint)`: a flow start-input warning) | 127669384323 |

Both logs carry the same line: `FAIL unit test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts > os validate is the read-only superset of os build (#3782, #4409) > …` then `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.` The other cli files in the shard pass. The file was last changed by PR #30712 (`a91ad429`, 2026-11-05T23:37Z) and PR #30336 (`1c537831`).

## Wanted

- Measure the case's wall time on CI and locally. It runs `os validate` and `os build` over a fixture and compares them, so the 5 s default leaves it no headroom on a loaded runner.
- Fix the cause: a fixture that does less work, a shared build, or an explicit per-case timeout sized from the measurement, with the reason in a comment. ⛔ No skip, no retry, no quarantine.
- Related, not a duplicate: #23181 (the cli test-budget ledger, `pm:on-hold`).
